append.detail: 2026-11-16 CORRECTION (SCAN-1207): the dates above are superseded by the owner's 2026-11-11 change. lib/core/launch-dates.ts now has LAUNCH_ON 2027-01-01 and the Public Beta running through 2027-01-31 (BETA_ENDS_ON); the three phases are Early Beta (intake closes Nov 30), Hosts Beta (Dec 31) and Public Beta (Jan 31). Where this row says beta ends 2026-12-31 or opening copy says December 1, read January 31 and January 1. December 31 is Hosts Beta intake only.
